title: 埋入式電源軌整合
summary: 以 4 階段、24 個工程工作包拆解埋軌隔離、熱相容及壓降，完成圖解、對照、敏感度分析、故障判別、量測規劃與驗收。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages explore rail isolation, thermal compatibility and voltage drop through diagrams, comparisons, sensitivity studies, fault diagnosis, measurement plans and acceptance reviews.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的雙語概念實作課；每步交付可審查的工程證據。24 步是學習拆解，不代表晶圓廠的完整配方。自行設定的數值須標為假設。題目不含可直接操作的化學混配、設備設定或量產公差；照片與外部影片為代表媒體，不是假稱每步實拍。
scopeEn: Bilingual conceptual exercises based on public principles, with reviewable evidence at each step. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete fab recipe. Chosen numerical inputs must be labeled hypothetical. No directly operable chemical mixtures, equipment settings or production tolerances are supplied. Photos and external videos are representative media, not claimed as recordings of every step.

stages.title: 電源路徑
stages.description: 在「電源路徑」建立六項互補證據，逐一檢查材料、幾何、物理機制與適用限制。
stages.descriptionEn: Build six complementary evidence items for power pathways, checking materials, geometry, mechanisms and validity limits.

steps.title: 電源與訊號分離
steps.objective: 完成「電源與訊號分離」的因果圖，把埋軌隔離、熱相容及壓降中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for separate power and signals, connecting relevant limits in rail isolation, thermal compatibility and voltage drop to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：電源與訊號分離。畫一張含作用前後狀態的原創圖；以箭頭標出本步原理中的因果關係；圈出一項仍需量測的未知量。判讀依據：埋入式軌改變電源位置，訊號仍需獨立連通。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Separate power and signals. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: Buried rails relocate power while signals still need separate connectivity. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「埋入式軌改變電源位置，訊號仍需獨立連通。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Buried rails relocate power while signals still need separate connectivity. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：總電流合格就證明每個通道都完整。 應回到「電源與訊號分離」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Acceptable total current proves every channel is intact. Revisit assumptions and sampling for separate power and signals and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「電源與訊號分離」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for separate power and signals: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine.

knowledge.title: 電源與訊號分離的原理
knowledge.text: 埋入式軌改變電源位置，訊號仍需獨立連通。
knowledge.textEn: Buried rails relocate power while signals still need separate connectivity.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 埋入軌是一種局部供電結構；電源從正面或背面進入是另一個設計維度，需以完整回路判定。
knowledge.textEn: A buried rail is a local power structure; frontside or backside entry is a separate design dimension requiring a complete loop.

quiz.question: 評估「電源與訊號分離」時，哪項敘述可以採用？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is valid when evaluating separate power and signals?
options: 埋入式軌改變電源位置，訊號仍需獨立連通。
總電流合格就證明每個通道都完整。
頂面膜厚代表所有側壁與底部厚度。
optionsEn: Buried rails relocate power while signals still need separate connectivity.
Acceptable total current proves every channel is intact.
Top thickness represents all sidewall and bottom thicknesses.
quiz.explanation: 埋入式軌改變電源位置，訊號仍需獨立連通。 埋入軌是一種局部供電結構；電源從正面或背面進入是另一個設計維度，需以完整回路判定。
quiz.explanationEn: Buried rails relocate power while signals still need separate connectivity. A buried rail is a local power structure; frontside or backside entry is a separate design dimension requiring a complete loop.

steps.title: 正面與背面入口
steps.objective: 完成「正面與背面入口」的對照表，把埋軌隔離、熱相容及壓降中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a controlled comparison for compare front and back access, connecting relevant limits in rail isolation, thermal compatibility and voltage drop to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：正面與背面入口。建立兩個只改一項條件的假想案例；分開記錄可觀察差異與推測原因；說明如何用本步原理區分兩者。判讀依據：有埋入軌不代表必然由背面供電。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Compare front and back access. Create two hypothetical cases differing in one condition; separate observations from proposed causes; use this step’s principle to distinguish them. Interpretation: Buried rails do not necessarily imply backside delivery. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「有埋入軌不代表必然由背面供電。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Buried rails do not necessarily imply backside delivery. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：總電流合格就證明每個通道都完整。 應回到「正面與背面入口」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Acceptable total current proves every channel is intact. Revisit assumptions and sampling for compare front and back access and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「正面與背面入口」對照表：交出兩案例、固定條件、預期差異及一項可能混淆因素。
steps.checkEn: Submit the controlled comparison for compare front and back access: Submit both cases, fixed conditions, predicted difference and one confounder.

steps.instruction: 本步問題：電流回路。選出本步的一項輸入及一項輸出；以自訂低、中、高三點畫趨勢；逐點標註假設，並寫出趨勢可能失效的條件。判讀依據：VDD 與回流路徑都貢獻元件壓降。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Trace the complete current loop. Select one input and output for this step; sketch a hypothetical low/mid/high trend; label assumptions and state when the trend may fail. Interpretation: Both supply and return contribute to device voltage drop. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「VDD 與回流路徑都貢獻元件壓降。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.check: 交付「電流回路」敏感度草圖：圖須有變數、單位或無因次定義、三個假設點及適用範圍。
steps.checkEn: Submit the sensitivity sketch for trace the complete current loop: Include variables, units or dimensionless definitions, three hypothetical points and validity limits.

steps.instruction: 本步問題：標準元件軌道。假設本步預期結果未出現；提出兩個不同機制；為各機制選一個能支持或否定的觀察，避免只重複同一量測。判讀依據：釋出的配線軌道需經實際佈線才能確認收益。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Budget cell tracks. Assume the expected result fails; propose two distinct mechanisms; choose an observation that supports or rejects each rather than repeating one measurement. Interpretation: Released tracks need routing verification to establish benefits. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「釋出的配線軌道需經實際佈線才能確認收益。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.checkEn: Submit the fault-discrimination table for budget cell tracks: List two hypotheses, discriminating evidence for each and a check order.

steps.instruction: 本步問題：埋入深度。針對本步定義待測量及採樣位置；列出解析度、背景與重複性；設計一個見證或空白，並說明檢出限如何限制結論。判讀依據：更深軌會改變隔離、加工難度與接觸長度。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Choose a depth study. Interpretation: Deeper rails change isolation, process difficulty and contact length. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
